about_the_game:
GAME FEATURES:


- Story mode with unlimited continues & checkpoints!
- AI team mates and/or local co-op.
- Unlockable 'random mode' (chaos turned up to 11 here).
- Perma-death (in random mode) - no continues allowed!
- A boss rush mode (with a Crystal comet twist).
- Unlockable spaceships / characters.
- Unlockable power-ups (unlock more for your 'run' when killing bosses).
- Multiple routes through story mode to reach the end.
- Multiple endings.

TONS OF REPLAYABILITY:


With randomised spawns, multiple characters & multiple routes through the story mode as well as multiple endings and a completely random mode (random mode seriously is random- don't say I didn't warn you!). Crystal comet the video game offers plenty to keep you coming back for more with short replayable gaming sessions.

The story mode is much more standardised than the random mode if random isn't your thing whilst still keeping things spicy.

NOT AS SIMPLE AS IT LOOKS:



In Crystal comet you can dominate using all the tools available to you:

- Warp if enemies trap you in a corner across the screen and escape.
- Boost to move faster and grab that power up before it goes off-screen.
- Fire your top gun in any direction.
- Fire your front guns like a normal shmup.
- Each ship also has a special ability - for those sticky situations!
- Drop power-ups for your teammates.
- Repair your teammate's ships!

STORY:


The galaxy is at peace... Suddenly the Crystal comet appears! - An object of great power and wealth corrupting the galaxy causing an all out war across a great many species. A team of unlikely allies forms consisting of the greatest spaceship pilots who ever lived to team up and find the source of the galaxy's corruption. Can they make it to the Crystal Comet in time? Or will they suffer a fate worse than death?

Let's keep this section 'spoiler' free... Good luck out there pilots!

CREDITS:


- Video game developed by RewdanSprites.

- Music by Paul Kixx.

- Level background designs by Mavy Orion.

- Marketing art by Curz Blayz.

ADDITIONAL INFO:

- Please note the game requires a control pad for local co-op but can be played with mouse & keyboard + controller(s).

Thanks for reading all of this! Here is a cheat code: Up, up, down, down eh... I'm just kidding!

content_descriptors.notes:
There is a lot of pixelated violence towards aliens, robots, humans & a mutant cow. 

The entire galaxy is caught in an all-out war in this game and there may be some themes that could be considered uncomfortable for some players.

There are some levels which may be deemed as scary. Some enemies may also jump scare the player although this is not a reoccurring theme throughout the game.

There is pixelated blood in some / most levels.

There are some scares / scary enemies in a minority of the levels.

There are some criminal acts such as thievery & killing. Although it is mostly pixelated violence. Few bosses may die looking in pain. There is the destruction of a city shown in minimalist detail during one cutscene.

Some endings may or may not be upsetting for some people. Depending on your journey and how you interpret things.

There is one ending with one partial swear word which is cut off but still easy to identify.

There are some adult themes without being overly vulgar.

short_description: An old-school chaotic twin stick space shoot em' up. You are not the hero - you're part of a squad! - Play single player with the AI or drop in / drop out local co-op!
